description: Why: loading all cache entries for eviction is O(n) in memory and will OOM or slow the runtime on large caches. What: block_cache.rs evict_for executes SELECT cid, file_path, byte_size FROM transit_block_cache ORDER BY last_access ASC with no LIMIT clause. For a cache with millions of entries this materializes the entire index into a Vec before any eviction decision. The query should SELECT only as many rows as needed to free the required bytes, using a LIMIT derived from the target bytes to free.
title: BlockCache::evict_for loads entire cache index without LIMIT
